verdict.rationale: Dover documents a REST API and publishes a machine-readable spec that users can use to generate their own client. No first-party, officially maintained SDK library appears in the evidence. A spec for self-generating clients is a developer building block, not an official SDK, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: Use it to generate a client or to give an AI coding tool the exact endpoints and fields.
